title: Text and Audio Processing Utilities
summary: This module provides processors for multimodal (text and image) models, specialized tokenizers for text with additional linguistic features, and utilities for normalizing numerical text, often used in speech processing pipelines.

nodes.label: Raw Text Input
nodes.title: Raw Text Input
nodes.description: Unprocessed text data provided by the user or an upstream system.

nodes.label: Raw Image Input
nodes.title: Raw Image Input
nodes.description: Unprocessed image data, potentially including multi-page documents or individual images.

nodes.label: Normalized Text
nodes.title: Normalized Text Output
nodes.description: Text data with numerical expressions converted into spelled-out word forms.

nodes.label: Model Input Tokens
nodes.title: Tokenized Model Input
nodes.description: Encoded text and/or image data, ready to be fed into a machine learning model.

nodes.label: Retrieval Scores
nodes.title: Retrieval Scores Output
nodes.description: Numerical scores indicating the relevance or similarity between queries and passages/documents.

nodes.label: Base Tokenization Logic
nodes.title: PreTrainedTokenizerBase
nodes.description: Foundation for all tokenizers, providing essential methods for text encoding, special token management, padding, and truncation.

nodes.label: RoCBert Text Tokenization
nodes.title: RoCBertTokenizer
nodes.description: Specialized tokenizer for RoCBert models that converts raw text into token IDs, and extracts additional linguistic features like word shape and pronunciation IDs.

nodes.label: ColModernVBert Multimodal Processing
nodes.title: ColModernVBertProcessor
nodes.description: Handles the preparation of both text and image inputs for ColModernVBert models, including visual prompting, and calculates late-interaction retrieval scores.

nodes.label: GotOcr2 Document Processing
nodes.title: GotOcr2Processor
nodes.description: Manages the preprocessing of images and text for GotOcr2 models, supporting multi-page documents, bounding box annotations, and OCR-specific text formatting.

nodes.label: English Number Normalization
nodes.title: EnglishNumberNormalizer
nodes.description: Converts numerical expressions (e.g., digits, currencies, percentages) within English text into their full spelled-out word forms for improved speech synthesis or text processing.

nodes.label: Idefics3 Image Preprocessing
nodes.title: Idefics3ImageProcessor
nodes.description: External component for processing images specifically for Idefics3 models, used by ColModernVBert.

nodes.label: Generic Image Preprocessing
nodes.title: Image Processor
nodes.description: External component for general image preprocessing, used by GotOcr2.

groups.label: Surface Components
groups.title: User-Facing Processors
groups.description: These components are the primary interfaces for users to prepare data for specific models or tasks.

groups.label: Generative Components
groups.title: Data Transformation
groups.description: Components responsible for transforming input data into a new format or representation.

groups.label: Analytical Components
groups.title: Data Analysis & Scoring
groups.description: Components that perform analysis or compute metrics on processed data.

groups.label: Data Flow
groups.title: External Data Interactions
groups.description: Represents the entry and exit points for data interacting with the module's components.
